title: Production plan and warehouse movement reconciliation
description: Read-only projection for one order. Quantities are expressed per product and plan unit. Amounts in this report are quantities, not money.

plans.description: Saved input and output plans within the report scope, including unfulfilled rows.

actuals.description: Surviving actual rows in scope. Keep an actual with a missing plan or movement link visible.

movements.description: Distinct in-scope warehouse journal rows whose origin identifies the order, including compensations.

movementTotals.description: One group for each product, warehouse and batch appearing in movements. Retain zero-net groups.

batch.description: Exact lot or serial text. Null denotes an absent value. Preserve strings with leading zeroes.

plan.description: One row per saved planned line. Confirm order, product, parent ID and corresponding role when matching actuals.

postedQuantity.description: Sum of signed matching surviving actual quantities, zero when none qualify.

remainingQuantity.description: Planned quantity less posted quantity. An overfulfilled plan has a negative remainder.

actual.description: One surviving actual. Map empty relationships or a zero sentinel to null. Movement direction is read independently from the journal.

quantity.description: Signed quantity in the production register.

movement.description: One journal row by identity. Movement type codes are 0 manual increase, 1 manual decrease, 2 automatic issue and 3 automatic receipt.

signedQuantity.description: Positive increases warehouse stock. Negative decreases it.

movementTotal.description: Change attributable to this order. Other warehouse transactions and beginning balances determine the on-hand quantity.

netQuantity.description: Sum of signed quantities over distinct movement rows in the group.
